notes.title: Difficulty setting now available! (version 1.2.3)
notes.content:
Hi all!

Since the game came out, one of the main gripes about it is that its difficulty curve can be quite steep. I won't lie to you: I like games presenting a certain amount of challenge, and Emerge was made with this mindset.

However, it is time to acknowledge that not everyone has the time or patience to master a challenging game. Therefore, I added a "Relaxed" game mode. By clicking the Options panel, you can set the difficulty to either "Normal" (default) or "Relaxed". You can change this setting anywhere in the game except during combat.

The Relaxed mode changes the following settings in the game:
[list]
    [*]Enemy max health is reduced by 30%
    [*]You get +5 credits per economy point
    [*]You get 10-12 crystals per turn
    [*]Team member unlock costs have been reduced by 25%
[/list]

As always, feedback and suggestions are welcome. Finally, I would like to inform you that Emerge will participate in the Weelkong Deal starting May 22 2017, with a 50% discount.

notes.title: Version 1.1 is live. New content and bug fixes!
notes.content:
v1.1.0
====================
Content
- Added 4 new items
- Added 3 new technologies

Bug fixes
- Fixed boss multiplication after fleeing from defenses
- Fixed Bolgia causing the game to freeze during combat
- Fixed random explore event resulting in negative/zero barricade health
- Fixed glitch in 'Gone with a bang' mission (Kowloon area) leading to mission failure despite requirements being met

Misc
- Diplomat skill also affect team slot unlocking costs
- Corrected minor typos
- Added credit symbol in recruit cost of member recruitment panel
